## Receptionist 2: Run Tool
Runs one Vapi tool call for **Receptionist 1** and always ends in `{ tool_call_id, result }`, where `result` is one line the voice model turns into speech.

All scheduling rules are code (`lib-slots.js`): opening hours, lunch, holidays, notice periods, 30-minute steps, 30 days ahead. Bookings and moves re-read the day and re-check the exact slot before writing, so two callers can't get the same time. Appointments are found by confirmation code or by the phone number they were booked with; nobody else's details are given out.
